segments.expected: "Some go white," said the Proprietor. "Some go out. And on the Long Quay in 2604, the lamps that went white were the lamps that kept time together, and the lamps that went out were the lamps that kept their own." He did not raise his voice. "That's my reading. It came to me a year after the window, and I've had it since I was twenty-seven. If whatever comes, comes again, I want this country's lamps white and not out. I want every bank stepped, every pump house, every box in every tenement, all keeping one time, so that whatever comes finds them lit." He looked at the Clerk. "That's why the foundation claims what it claims. Not for the ash. I don't want the ash.
